title: Source countries
markdown:
### Geographic Origins of Attack Traffic

In aggregate data covering all products, Brazil rose from rank 10 [F-024] to rank 3 [F-024] with a 246.4% increase in volume [F-024]. China remained the top source country for attacks in 2026 [F-017], accounting for 895,100 attack volume [F-017] and 20.0% of all attack volume [F-017].

For email gateway traffic specifically, Chinese-origin attacks increased by 55.7% to become the top attacking country with 205,490 blocked incidents [F-010]. In firewall products, China was the top source country of attacks in 2026, accounting for 895,100 volume [F-017]. Brazil emerged as the second-largest source country of attacks for firewalls with a 211.6% increase from the previous year [F-016]. This volume reached 668,293 incidents [F-016], representing 14.9% of firewall traffic [F-016]. For email gateway traffic, Brazil became the country at rank 3 [F-009] with a 549.0% increase in attacks [F-009]. This product saw 154,209 incidents from Brazil and a share of 15.0% [F-009].

All geographic data is based on IP geolocation of the attacking infrastructure, not attribution of the attacker [F-009]. VPNs, proxies and compromised hosts are common [F-009]. Summed across products like email gateway and firewall, one attack can be seen by more than one product, so this may overcount attacks [F-024].
